admit site vm of f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01 as paisans-f2a9 on fake (ubuntu 24.04)

step 1: claim the host
  registry: record deployment f2a9 in /var/lib/paisans/registry.json, so no other deployment here takes its token, directory, interface, port, subnet or roles (witness)
  run:
    $ set -e; umask 077; mkdir -p /var/lib/paisans; chmod 711 /var/lib/paisans; exec 9>>/var/lib/paisans/registry.lock; flock -w 60 9 || { echo 'paisans: another command holds /var/lib/paisans/registry.lock'; exit 1; }; tmp=$(mktemp /var/lib/paisans/.registry.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT; src=/var/lib/paisans/registry.json; [ -f "$src" ] || src=/dev/null; awk '-v' 'id=f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01' '-v' 'token=f2a9' '-v' 'root=/srv/paisans/f2a9' '-v' 'iface=psns-f2a9' '-v' 'port=51820' '-v' 'subnet=10.44.0.0/24' '-v' 'roles=witness' '-v' 'site=vm' '-v' 'address=10.44.0.3' '-v' 'entry="f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01":{"token":"f2a9","root":"/srv/paisans/f2a9","domain":"","site":"vm","claimed_at":"2026-10-15T12:00:00Z","interface":"psns-f2a9","listen_port":51820,"subnet":"10.44.0.0/24","address":"10.44.0.3","roles":"witness"}' '-v' 'header={"version":1,"deployments":{' '-v' 'footer=}}' '-v' 'marker=paisans-registry-conflict ' '-v' 'unreadable=paisans-registry-unreadable' '
    $ function str(line, name,   key, i, rest) {
    $ 	key = "\"" name "\":\""
    $ 	i = index(line, key)
    $ 	if (!i) return ""
    $ 	rest = substr(line, i + length(key))
    $ 	return substr(rest, 1, index(rest, "\"") - 1)
    $ }
    $ function num(line, name,   key, i, rest) {
    $ 	key = "\"" name "\":"
    $ 	i = index(line, key)
    $ 	if (!i) return ""
    $ 	rest = substr(line, i + length(key))
    $ 	if (!match(rest, /^[0-9]+/)) return ""
    $ 	return substr(rest, 1, RLENGTH)
    $ }
    $ function hasrole(list, r) {
    $ 	return list != "" && index("," list ",", "," r ",") > 0
    $ }
    $ function ipnum(a,   p) {
    $ 	split(a, p, ".")
    $ 	return ((p[1] * 256 + p[2]) * 256 + p[3]) * 256 + p[4]
    $ }
    $ function overlaps(a, b,   pa, pb, la, lb, sa, sb) {
    $ 	if (a == "" || b == "") return 0
    $ 	split(a, pa, "/"); split(b, pb, "/")
    $ 	la = 2 ^ (32 - pa[2]); lb = 2 ^ (32 - pb[2])
    $ 	sa = ipnum(pa[1]); sa -= sa % la
    $ 	sb = ipnum(pb[1]); sb -= sb % lb
    $ 	return sa < sb + lb && sb < sa + la
    $ }
    $ NR == 1 { if ($0 != header) bad = 1; next }
    $ done { if ($0 != "") bad = 1; next }
    $ $0 == footer { done = 1; next }
    $ {
    $ 	line = $0
    $ 	sub(/,$/, "", line)
    $ 	if (line !~ /^"[^"]+":\{.*\}$/) { bad = 1; next }
    $ 	key = substr(line, 2, index(line, "\":") - 2)
    $ 	if (key == id) {
    $ 		s = str(line, "site"); a = str(line, "address")
    $ 		if ((s != "" && site != "") ? (s != site) : (a != "" && address != "" && a != address)) {
    $ 			print marker line > "/dev/stderr"
    $ 			conflict = 1
    $ 		}
    $ 		next
    $ 	}
    $ 	if (index(line, "\"token\":\"" token "\"") || index(line, "\"root\":\"" root "\"") ||
    $ 		str(line, "interface") == iface ||
    $ 		(port != "" && port != "0" && num(line, "listen_port") == port) ||
    $ 		(subnet != "" && overlaps(subnet, str(line, "subnet"))) ||
    $ 		(hasrole(roles, "gateway") && hasrole(str(line, "roles"), "gateway")) ||
    $ 		(hasrole(roles, "data") && hasrole(str(line, "roles"), "data"))) {
    $ 		print marker line > "/dev/stderr"
    $ 		conflict = 1
    $ 	}
    $ 	kept[++n] = line
    $ }
    $ END {
    $ 	if (NR > 0 && !done) bad = 1
    $ 	if (bad) { print unreadable > "/dev/stderr"; exit 4 }
    $ 	if (conflict) exit 3
    $ 	print header
    $ 	for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) print kept[i] ","
    $ 	print entry
    $ 	print footer
    $ }
    $ ' "$src" > "$tmp"; chmod 600 "$tmp"; mv "$tmp" /var/lib/paisans/registry.json

step 2: create /etc/paisans
  record: root's, mode 755: every deployment's user reads its own record, none can write one
  run:
    $ install -d -m 755 -o root -g root /etc/paisans

step 3: start paisans-f2a9's manager after the mesh
  user: order user@1001.service after wg-quick@psns-f2a9 at boot, so a container that publishes on the mesh address finds it; a manager running now is not restarted, and takes it at its next start
  write /etc/systemd/system/user@1001.service.d/paisans-mesh.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans host admit for deployment f2a9; paisans host evict
    | # removes it. The user's manager, its Docker daemon and its containers
    | # start after the mesh at boot.
    | [Unit]
    | Wants=wg-quick@psns-f2a9.service
    | After=wg-quick@psns-f2a9.service
  run:
    $ systemctl daemon-reload

step 4: delegate cgroups to users
  delegation: let every user's manager delegate cpu cpuset io memory pids, for compose's limits; paisans-f2a9's manager is running, and takes it at its next start
  write /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d/delegate.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans host admit. Shared by every admitted deployment;
    | # paisans host evict removes it with the last of them.
    | [Service]
    | Delegate=cpu cpuset io memory pids
  run:
    $ systemctl daemon-reload

step 5: load the egress table
  egress: load paisans_f2a9 now
  run:
    $ systemctl start paisans-f2a9-egress.service && nft -f /etc/paisans/egress.f2a9.nft

step 6: load br_netfilter
  daemon: load br_netfilter now, which the user's daemon needs with its userland proxy off
  run:
    $ modprobe br_netfilter

step 7: load br_netfilter at boot
  daemon: list br_netfilter and nf_tables in /etc/modules-load.d/paisans.conf, shared by every admitted deployment
  write /etc/modules-load.d/paisans.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans host admit. The rootless Docker daemons of admitted
    | # deployments need br_netfilter to start with their userland proxy off,
    | # and the module their iptables uses for the setup tool to install them.
    | br_netfilter
    | nf_tables

step 8: write paisans-f2a9's daemon.json
  daemon: userland proxy off, address pools clear of the mesh; written as paisans-f2a9
  run:
    $ runuser -u paisans-f2a9 -- env -i HOME='/home/paisans-f2a9' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1001 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1001/bus DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/1001/docker.sock sh -c 'umask 077 && mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/docker" && cat > "$HOME/.config/docker/.daemon.json.paisans-tmp" && mv -f "$HOME/.config/docker/.daemon.json.paisans-tmp" "$HOME/.config/docker/daemon.json"'
  stdin:
    | {
    |   "userland-proxy": false,
    |   "default-address-pools": [
    |     {
    |       "base": "172.17.0.0/16",
    |       "size": 24
    |     },
    |     {
    |       "base": "172.18.0.0/16",
    |       "size": 24
    |     },
    |     {
    |       "base": "172.19.0.0/16",
    |       "size": 24
    |     },
    |     {
    |       "base": "172.20.0.0/14",
    |       "size": 24
    |     },
    |     {
    |       "base": "172.24.0.0/14",
    |       "size": 24
    |     },
    |     {
    |       "base": "172.28.0.0/14",
    |       "size": 24
    |     },
    |     {
    |       "base": "192.168.0.0/16",
    |       "size": 24
    |     }
    |   ]
    | }

step 9: install paisans-f2a9's rootless Docker
  daemon: dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install --force, as paisans-f2a9, which starts the daemon reading its daemon.json; --force because a system daemon may run beside it
  run:
    $ runuser -u paisans-f2a9 -- env -i HOME='/home/paisans-f2a9' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1001 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1001/bus DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/1001/docker.sock sh -c 'dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install --force'

step 10: create /srv/paisans
  directory: every deployment's directory lives in it, root's, mode 755
  run:
    $ install -d -m 755 -o root -g root /srv/paisans

step 11: create /srv/paisans/f2a9
  directory: the deployment's own, paisans-f2a9's, mode 750
  run:
    $ install -d -m 750 -o paisans-f2a9 -g paisans-f2a9 /srv/paisans/f2a9

step 12: create /etc/wireguard
  wireguard: root's, mode 700, so the deployment's user cannot plant a conf the helper has not checked
  run:
    $ install -d -m 700 -o root -g root /etc/wireguard

step 13: create /usr/local/libexec/paisans
  wireguard: where each deployment's helper lives, root's, mode 755
  run:
    $ install -d -m 755 -o root -g root /usr/local/libexec/paisans

step 14: install the WireGuard helper
  wireguard: the one command paisans-f2a9 may run as root: it checks each conf before wg-quick sees it, and adds the mesh's mark
  write /usr/local/libexec/paisans/wg-psns-f2a9 mode 0755:
    | <the WireGuard helper hostprep renders, sha256 542d778f41048261ba002ec01f165aabc9f60ee16acb57fc2f387844ae5e0fee>

step 15: install the helper's sudoers line
  wireguard: /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9, mode 440, checked by visudo under a name sudo skips before it is moved into place
  write /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9.new mode 0440:
    | paisans-f2a9 ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/local/libexec/paisans/wg-psns-f2a9
  run:
    $ visudo -cqf /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9.new && chown root:root /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9.new && mv -f /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9.new /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9 || { rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9.new; echo 'visudo refused the line; nothing reached sudo'; exit 1; }

step 16: allow 22/tcp
  firewall: allow 22/tcp (ssh, the bootstrap route)
  run:
    $ ufw allow 22/tcp comment 'paisans-f2a9: ssh, the bootstrap route'

step 17: allow 51820/udp
  firewall: allow 51820/udp (WireGuard, the mesh)
  run:
    $ ufw allow 51820/udp comment 'paisans-f2a9: WireGuard, the mesh'

step 18: allow all inbound on psns-f2a9
  firewall: allow all inbound on psns-f2a9 (the mesh: etcd, Patroni, Garage, HAProxy)
  run:
    $ ufw allow in on psns-f2a9 comment 'paisans-f2a9: the mesh: etcd, Patroni, Garage, HAProxy'

step 19: write the admission record
  record: who the deployment runs as and what you granted, which its own commands read
  write /etc/paisans/admitted.f2a9.json mode 0644:
    | {
    |   "version": 1,
    |   "deployment": "f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01",
    |   "user": "paisans-f2a9",
    |   "grants": {
    |     "watchdog": false,
    |     "public_ports": false
    |   },
    |   "forwarding": false,
    |   "ports": {
    |     "ssh": 22,
    |     "wireguard": 51820,
    |     "public": []
    |   },
    |   "digest": "aadq-v10p-2qb7-jrsq",
    |   "admitted_at": "2026-10-15T12:00:00Z",
    |   "data_dir": "",
    |   "bridge_netfilter": false,
    |   "mesh_lan": "",
    |   "web_server": null
    | }

step 20: add the operators' keys
  keys: 1 operator key into paisans-f2a9's authorized_keys, written as paisans-f2a9, and recorded in /srv/paisans/f2a9/.paisans/authorized_keys.owned for host prepare
  run:
    $ runuser -u paisans-f2a9 -- env -i HOME='/home/paisans-f2a9' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1001 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1001/bus DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/1001/docker.sock sh -c 'set -e; umask 077; mkdir -p "$HOME/.ssh" /srv/paisans/f2a9/.paisans
    $ tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap '\''rm -rf "$tmp"'\'' EXIT
    $ awk -v k="$tmp/keys" -v s="$tmp/sidecar" '\''$0 == "--- sidecar ---" { out = 1; next } { if (out) print > s; else print > k }'\''
    $ touch "$tmp/keys" "$tmp/sidecar"
    $ f="$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
    $ { if [ -e "$f" ] || [ -L "$f" ]; then awk 1 "$f"; fi; cat "$tmp/keys"; } > "$HOME/.ssh/.authorized_keys.paisans-tmp"
    $ mv -f "$HOME/.ssh/.authorized_keys.paisans-tmp" "$f"
    $ cat "$tmp/sidecar" > /srv/paisans/f2a9/.paisans/authorized_keys.owned.paisans-tmp
    $ mv -f /srv/paisans/f2a9/.paisans/authorized_keys.owned.paisans-tmp /srv/paisans/f2a9/.paisans/authorized_keys.owned'
  stdin:
    | ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA alice
    | --- sidecar ---
    | # Keys this deployment claims in paisans-f2a9's authorized_keys: <mark> <fingerprint> <name>. host prepare removes a line only when it is marked added here and no other deployment's file lists it.
    | added SHA256:kmYcvdi2GkPeWxB6XLjrZB8JHsy2Hm8luHMFp9GMvqk alice

present: mesh: nothing on this host overlaps 10.44.0.0/24

present: forwarding: not needed, this site has no endpoint
warning: delegation reaches paisans-f2a9's manager at its next start
  Its manager is running, and restarting it would restart its Docker daemon and every container in it, so admit does not. cpuset and io limits apply after the host's next reboot.
